title: Identify the top 10 and bottom 10 interest categories based on their highes
question: Identify the top 10 and bottom 10 interest categories based on their highest composition values across all months. For each category, display the time(MM-YYYY), interest name, and the composition value

prediction.sql:
WITH per_cat AS (
  SELECT m.interest_id,
         i.interest_name,
         m.month_year,
         m.composition,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.interest_id ORDER BY m.composition DESC, m.month_year) AS rn
  FROM interest_metrics m
  JOIN interest_map i ON i.id = m.interest_id
  WHERE m.month_year IS NOT NULL
),
best AS (
  SELECT interest_id, interest_name, month_year, composition
  FROM per_cat
  WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT month_year, interest_name, composition
FROM (
  SELECT month_year, interest_name, composition,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY composition DESC, interest_name) AS r
  FROM best
)
WHERE r <= 10

persistent_recovery_advisory_draft.base_sql:
WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT m.interest_id, m.month_year, m.composition,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.interest_id ORDER BY m.composition DESC) rn
  FROM interest_metrics m
),
best AS (
  SELECT r.interest_id, r.month_year, r.composition,
         RANK() OVER (ORDER BY r.composition DESC) rdesc
  FROM ranked r WHERE r.rn = 1
)
SELECT b.month_year AS time, i.interest_name, b.composition
FROM best b JOIN interest_map i ON i.id = b.interest_id
WHERE b.rdesc <= 10
ORDER BY b.composition DESC
